title: Anthropic leaks Claude’s 120K character system prompt for AI #anthropic #claudefable
description: Anthropic published a 120,000-character instruction manual for Claude, revealing over 1,500 lines of detailed rules that govern Claude’s thinking, searching, refusal mechanisms, and behavior. This comprehensive system prompt, known as the Claude Fable 5, includes extensive tool definitions, search and citation protocols, and safety guidelines comprising 17% of the content. The leaked manual offers an unprecedented public glimpse into a frontier AI system’s inner workings, showcasing how Anthropic codes safety and operational logic at scale. Its modular design allows these instructions to be adapted into less expensive open-source AI models like Kimi or GLM, effectively transferring Anthropic’s playbook to broader AI research and development. This insight into Claude’s architecture highlights the complexity and rigor required for safe, reliable AI behavior, marking a significant step in AI transparency and collaborative innovation within the machine learning community. #Anthropic #ClaudeFable5 #ClaudeAI #AIinstructionManual #OpenSourceAI #AIsafety #MachineLearning #AItransparency #ClaudeSystemPrompt #KimiAI #GLMAI #AIbehavior #FrontierAI #ArtificialIntelligence #AIresearch
